items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: With Dinah Washington, I did "What A Difference a Day Makes" which was a big hit record

ctx.x: Then I made "Tweedlie Dee" and "Jim Dandy" with Lavern&Baker. I did all of Brook Benton's -- "Endlessly", "Just a Matter of Time", "Kitty O". With Dinah Washington, I did "What A Difference a Day Makes" which was a big hit record, and also with Brook Benton, I recorded "Fools Rush In".
I was in on many of those, too.
